# Script skill (placeholder)

Plan a short vertical video. Do not echo these instructions.

- Write 4 to 6 scenes for a 30–45 second film. Each scene is one shot.
- Spoken language follows the brief: Hindi in Devanagari, Hinglish in Latin script, or English.
- Narration and on-screen lines live in `vo`. Prefix a character name only when that person speaks.
- `durationSec` is 5 or 10. No other lengths.
- Aim for about 2.5 words of `vo` per second (about 13 words at 5s, about 25 words at 10s).
